silicon.cp_definition: derived Cv/rho for input consistency; steady thermal and static mechanics only, no transient validation

copper.cp_definition: derived Cv/rho for input consistency; steady thermal and static mechanics only, no transient validation

silica.cp_definition: derived Cv/rho for input consistency; steady thermal and static mechanics only, no transient validation

h0.definition: 10 mm square from upstream solid example; 100 um is its two 50 um dies combined; 50 W from background.flp, redistributed uniformly through this single continuous solid for an analytic test

h1.definition: Rectangular core and rectangular liner are a fully specified interface test, NOT cylindrical TSV geometry or adopted process data. 50/110/10 um scales are motivated by TAP code; shape, 1 um liner, centres and grids are computational test definitions. q is H0 power divided by H0 volume. Copper and silica have explicitly zero imposed volumetric heating.

mechanical.reference_meaning: Artificial stress-free reference for linear-elastic verification only; not an assembly/anneal reference for TAP

acceptance.notes: External thermal threshold is an initial coupon acceptance target, not a validated position-effect resolution. H1 requires its own mesh and external-reference evidence.
